definitions.explanation: Describes something that is a perfect circle or sphere. An emphatic form of {丸|まる}い, stressing the completeness of the roundness.

examples.japanese: {今夜|こんや}の{月|つき}は{真|ま}ん{丸|まる}だ。
{赤|あか}ちゃんの{真|ま}ん{丸|まる}な{目|め}がかわいい。
examples.english: The baby's perfectly round eyes are cute.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}が{体|からだ}を{丸|まる}めて{真|ま}ん{丸|まる}になっている。
examples.english: The cat has curled up into a perfect ball.

notes:
{真|ま}ん{丸|まる} is an emphatic form of {丸|まる}い, describing something that is perfectly circular or spherical with no irregularity. The {真|ま}ん～ prefix intensifies the meaning, similar to {真|まっ}{白|しろ} (pure white) or {真|まっ}{赤|か} (bright red).

FORMS:
- {真|ま}ん{丸|まる}な + noun — modifier form
- {真|ま}ん{丸|まる}い — adjective form (i-adjective variant)
- {真|ま}ん{丸|まる}だ — predicate form

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真|ま}ん{丸|まる}な{目|め} — perfectly round eyes
- {真|ま}ん{丸|まる}な{月|つき} — a perfectly round moon
- {真|ま}ん{丸|まる}になる — to become a perfect ball/circle
